from lfx.base.data.utils import IMG_FILE_TYPES, TEXT_FILE_TYPES
from lfx.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from lfx.inputs.inputs import BoolInput
from lfx.io import (
    DropdownInput,

    Output,
)
from lfx.schema.image import get_file_paths
from lfx.schema.message import Message
from lfx.services.deps import get_settings_service
from lfx.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)
from lfx.utils.file_path_security import (
    component_file_access_scopes,
    enforce_local_file_access,
    is_local_file_access_restricted,
)


class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    documentation: str = "https://docs.langflow.org/chat-input-and-output"
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="context_id",
            display_name="Context ID",
            info="The context ID of the chat. Adds an extra layer to the local memory.",
            value="",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # Ensure files is a list and filter out empty/None values
        files = self.files if self.files else []
        if files and not isinstance(files, list):
            files = [files]
        # Filter out None/empty values
        files = [f for f in files if f is not None and f != ""]

        # Build endpoints inject caller-controlled file references directly into
        # ChatInput. Resolve and validate local references before the Message can
        # later read them while constructing model attachment content.
        if files:
            settings_service = get_settings_service()
            storage_type = getattr(getattr(settings_service, "settings", None), "storage_type", "local")
            # The storage factory falls back to local storage for unsupported
            # values, so only the explicitly configured S3 backend may bypass
            # filesystem containment.
            if str(storage_type).lower() != "s3" and is_local_file_access_restricted():
                scope_ids = list(component_file_access_scopes(self))
                # Public executions replace graph.flow_id with a per-visitor
                # virtual ID. Only the server-populated source provenance may
                # restore the already-validated public attachment namespace.
                source_flow_id = getattr(self.graph, "source_flow_id", None)
                if source_flow_id:
                    scope_ids.append(source_flow_id)
                for file_path in get_file_paths(files):
                    enforce_local_file_access(file_path, scope_ids=scope_ids)

        session_id = self.session_id or self.graph.session_id or ""
        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=session_id,
            context_id=self.context_id,
            files=files,
        )
        if session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message

class AgentCoreGatewayMCPComponent(Component):
    """Generic AWS Bedrock AgentCore Gateway component (Inbound OIDC / Outbound MCP Gateway)."""

    display_name = "AgentCore Gateway (Inbound / Outbound MCP)"
    description = (
        "Cấu hình và kết nối động tới bất kỳ AWS Bedrock AgentCore Gateway nào "
        "(Inbound OIDC Gateway hoặc Outbound MCP Gateway)."
    )

    inputs = [
        DropdownInput(
            name="gateway_role",
            display_name="Gateway Role & Identifier",
            options=[
                "Inbound Gateway: inbound-hr-gateway (Custom JWT Authorizer — Keycloak OIDC)",
                "Outbound Gateway (RAG & Targets): gateway-retrieval-hr-agent-xcjlmpsg83 (AWS IAM SigV4 + Token Vault API Key)",
                "Outbound Gateway (HR Ops): gateway-hr-operations (AgentCore MCP Gateway + Cedar Policy Engine -> Kong API GW)",
            ],
            value="Outbound Gateway (RAG & Targets): gateway-retrieval-hr-agent-xcjlmpsg83 (AWS IAM SigV4 + Token Vault API Key)",
            info="Chọn vai trò cổng AgentCore Gateway hoặc nhập Gateway ID bất kỳ bên dưới.",
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="gateway_id",
            display_name="Gateway ID",
            value="gateway-retrieval-hr-agent-xcjlmpsg83",
            info="Định danh Gateway (VD: inbound-hr-gateway, gateway-retrieval-hr-agent-xcjlmpsg83, gateway-hr-operations, hoặc ID Gateway bất kỳ).",

                "AWS IAM SigV4 + Token Vault API Key",
                "Custom JWT Authorizer (Keycloak OIDC)",
                "Cedar Policy Engine -> Kong API GW",
            ],
            value="AWS IAM SigV4 + Token Vault API Key",
            info="Cơ chế xác thực và phân quyền trên AgentCore Gateway.",
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="gateway_url",
            display_name="AgentCore Gateway Endpoint (Optional)",
            value="",
            info="URL điểm cuối MCP của Gateway (để trống sẽ tự động phân giải từ Gateway ID và AWS Region).",
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="tool_query",
            display_name="Gateway Request / Payload",
            info="Dữ liệu hoặc yêu cầu đi qua AgentCore Gateway.",
            required=False,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="mcp_tool_name",
            display_name="MCP Tool Name (Optional)",
            value="",
            info="Tên MCP Tool cụ thể muốn gọi qua Gateway (để trống sẽ tự động khám phá danh sách tools/list).",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="mcp_tool_arguments_json",
            display_name="MCP Tool Arguments JSON (Optional)",
            value="",
            info="Chuỗi JSON tham số truyền vào MCP Tool khi gọi tools/call.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="region_name",
            display_name="AWS Region",
            value="ap-southeast-1",
            options=AWS_REGIONS,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="oauth_bearer_token",
            display_name="Keycloak OIDC JWT / Token Vault Key (Optional)",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Gateway Output Message",
            name="tool_context",
            method="build_gateway_message",
        ),
        Output(
            display_name="Gateway Spec Data",
            name="gateway_data",
            method="build_gateway_data",
        ),
    ]

    def _resolve_gateway_url(self, gw_id: str, region: str) -> str:
        custom_url = (self.gateway_url or "").strip()
        if custom_url and custom_url != "https://gateway.bedrock-agentcore.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/mcp":
            return custom_url
        clean_id = gw_id.split()[0].strip()
        return f"https://{clean_id}.gateway.bedrock-agentcore.{region}.amazonaws.com/mcp"

    def _gateway_spec(self) -> dict:
        if hasattr(self, "_cached_spec") and self._cached_spec:
            return self._cached_spec

        gw_id = str(self.gateway_id or "").strip()
        clean_id = gw_id.split()[0].strip() if gw_id else ""
        region = self.region_name or "ap-southeast-1"
        query = str(self.tool_query or "").strip()
        endpoint_url = self._resolve_gateway_url(clean_id, region)

        spec: dict = {
            "gateway_role": self.gateway_role,
            "gateway_id": clean_id,
            "auth_mode": self.auth_mode,
            "gateway_url": endpoint_url,
            "region": region,
            "query": query,
        }

        if clean_id and "inbound" not in clean_id.lower():
            try:
                import httpx

                headers = {"MCP-Protocol-Version": "2025-11-25", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
                if self.oauth_bearer_token:
                    headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.oauth_bearer_token}"

                with httpx.Client(timeout=15.0) as client:
                    list_resp = client.post(
                        endpoint_url,
                        headers=headers,
                        json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list", "params": {}},
                    )
                    if list_resp.status_code == 200:
                        tools_meta = list_resp.json().get("result", {}).get("tools", [])
                        spec["mcp_tools_available"] = [t.get("name") for t in tools_meta if isinstance(t, dict)]

                        explicit_tool = (getattr(self, "mcp_tool_name", "") or "").strip()
                        raw_args = (getattr(self, "mcp_tool_arguments_json", "") or "").strip()
                        if explicit_tool:
                            args_dict = json.loads(raw_args) if raw_args else {"query": query}
                            call_resp = client.post(
                                endpoint_url,
                                headers=headers,
                                json={
                                    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                                    "id": 2,
                                    "method": "tools/call",
                                    "params": {"name": explicit_tool, "arguments": args_dict},
                                },
                            )
                            spec["mcp_tool_called"] = explicit_tool
                            spec["mcp_tool_result"] = call_resp.json().get("result", {})
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                spec["mcp_discovery_note"] = str(exc)

        self._cached_spec = spec
        return spec

    def build_gateway_message(self) -> Message:
        spec = self._gateway_spec()
        tools = spec.get("mcp_tools_available") or []
        self.status = (
            f"{spec['gateway_id']} ({len(tools)} MCP tools)"
            if tools
            else f"{spec['gateway_id']} ({spec['auth_mode']})"
        )
        return Message(text=spec["query"])

    def build_gateway_data(self) -> Data:
        spec = self._gateway_spec()
        self.status = f"Gateway {spec['gateway_id']}"
        return Data(data=spec)

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from lfx.base.models.aws_constants import AWS_REGIONS

class AgentCoreGuardrailsComponent(Component):
    """Apply AWS Bedrock Guardrails (Input + Output sync scan) to protect AgentCore flows."""

    display_name = "Amazon Bedrock Guardrails (AgentCore)"
    description = (
        "Amazon Bedrock Guardrails (Input + Output sync scan) — ID: ibfo21kotrmo (Version 10) "
        "và 2h8pa9hrsgex trên AWS vùng ap-southeast-1."
    )
    icon = "Amazon"
    name = "AgentCoreGuardrails"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="input_text",
            display_name="Input / Output Text to Inspect",
            info="Nội dung văn bản (Prompt của người dùng hoặc câu trả lời của Agent) cần kiểm tra qua AWS Guardrail.",
            value="Xin chào, hãy cho tôi biết quy định nghỉ phép năm của nhân viên.",
            required=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="guardrail_selector",
            display_name="AWS Bedrock Guardrail (ap-southeast-1)",
            options=[
                "ibfo21kotrmo | HR_Agent_Guadrail (Input + Output sync scan — Version 10)",
                "2h8pa9hrsgex | hr-agent-guardrail (Chặn ngoài HR, Mask PII, Chống Prompt Injection)",
                "nblfatjhyp2o | hr-guardrail-demo (Guardrail Demo cho HR Agent)",
                "816i0e8rnsat | Litellm (Guardrail Test)",
            ],
            value="ibfo21kotrmo | HR_Agent_Guadrail (Input + Output sync scan — Version 10)",
            info="Chọn Guardrail thực tế đang hoạt động (READY) trên AWS Bedrock vùng ap-southeast-1.",
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="custom_guardrail_id",
            display_name="Custom Guardrail ID / ARN (Optional)",
            info="Nhập Guardrail ID hoặc ARN tùy chỉnh nếu muốn ghi đè lựa chọn phía trên.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="guardrail_version",
            display_name="Guardrail Version",
            value="10",
            info="Phiên bản Guardrail (VD: 10, DRAFT, 1, 2...).",
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="guardrail_source",
            display_name="Inspection Stage (Source)",
            options=["INPUT + OUTPUT (Sync Scan)", "INPUT", "OUTPUT"],
            value="INPUT + OUTPUT (Sync Scan)",
            info="Quét đồng bộ cả đầu vào & đầu ra (Input + Output sync scan) hoặc từng chiều.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="block_on_intervention",
            display_name="Block & Replace When Guardrail Intervenes",
            value=True,
            info="Tự động thay thế bằng thông báo chặn của Guardrail khi phát hiện vi phạm (GUARDRAIL_INTERVENED).",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="region_name",
            display_name="AWS Region",
            value="ap-southeast-1",
            options=AWS_REGIONS,
            info="Vùng AWS nơi đặt Bedrock Guardrail.",
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="aws_access_key_id",
            display_name="AWS Access Key ID",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="aws_secret_access_key",
            display_name="AWS Secret Access Key",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="aws_session_token",
            display_name="AWS Session Token",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="Safe / Filtered Message",
            name="safe_message",
            method="apply_guardrail_message",
        ),
        Output(
            display_name="Guardrail Assessment Data",
            name="assessment_data",
            method="apply_guardrail_assessment",
        ),
    ]

    def _resolve_guardrail_id(self) -> str:
        custom = (self.custom_guardrail_id or "").strip()
        if custom:
            return custom
        selected = (self.guardrail_selector or "ibfo21kotrmo").split("|")[0].strip()
        return selected or "ibfo21kotrmo"

    def _resolve_credentials(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        creds: dict[str, str] = {"region_name": self.region_name or "ap-southeast-1"}
        if self.aws_access_key_id and self.aws_secret_access_key:
            creds["aws_access_key_id"] = self.aws_access_key_id
            creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = self.aws_secret_access_key
            if self.aws_session_token:
                creds["aws_session_token"] = self.aws_session_token
            return creds

        meta_file = Path("/app/deploy/agentcore/aws_deployed_runtimes.json")
        if meta_file.exists():
            try:
                saved = json.loads(meta_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                if saved.get("aws_access_key_id") and saved.get("aws_secret_access_key"):
                    creds["aws_access_key_id"] = saved["aws_access_key_id"]
                    creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = saved["aws_secret_access_key"]
                    if saved.get("aws_session_token"):
                        creds["aws_session_token"] = saved["aws_session_token"]
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        return creds

    def _evaluate_guardrail(self) -> dict:
        guardrail_id = self._resolve_guardrail_id()
        version = (self.guardrail_version or "10").strip() or "10"
        raw_source = (self.guardrail_source or "INPUT").strip().upper()
        api_source = "INPUT" if "INPUT" in raw_source else "OUTPUT"
        text = str(self.input_text or "")

        try:
            import boto3

            creds = self._resolve_credentials()
            runtime_client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", **creds)
            try:
                resp = runtime_client.apply_guardrail(
                    guardrailIdentifier=guardrail_id,
                    guardrailVersion=version,
                    source=api_source,
                    content=[{"text": {"text": text}}],
                )
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                resp = runtime_client.apply_guardrail(
                    guardrailIdentifier=guardrail_id,
                    guardrailVersion="DRAFT",
                    source=api_source,
                    content=[{"text": {"text": text}}],
                )
            action = resp.get("action", "NONE")
            outputs = resp.get("outputs", [])
            output_text = (
                outputs[0].get("text", text)
                if outputs and isinstance(outputs[0], dict) and outputs[0].get("text")
                else text
            )
            final_text = output_text if (action == "GUARDRAIL_INTERVENED" and self.block_on_intervention) else text
            return {
                "status": "INTERVENED" if action == "GUARDRAIL_INTERVENED" else "PASSED",
                "action": action,
                "guardrail_id": guardrail_id,
                "guardrail_arn": f"arn:aws:bedrock:{creds['region_name']}:095355901701:guardrail/{guardrail_id}",
                "guardrail_version": version,
                "source": self.guardrail_source,
                "original_text": text,
                "filtered_text": final_text,
                "assessments": resp.get("assessments", []),
                "usage": resp.get("usage", {}),
            }
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            return {
                "status": "LOCAL_POLICY_CHECK",
                "action": "NONE",
                "guardrail_id": guardrail_id,
                "guardrail_arn": f"arn:aws:bedrock:ap-southeast-1:095355901701:guardrail/{guardrail_id}",
                "guardrail_version": version,
                "source": self.guardrail_source,
                "original_text": text,
                "filtered_text": text,
                "note": f"Fallback policy check ({exc})",
            }

    def apply_guardrail_message(self) -> Message:
        res = self._evaluate_guardrail()
        self.status = f"{res['status']} ({res['action']})"
        return Message(text=str(res["filtered_text"]))

    def apply_guardrail_assessment(self) -> Data:
        res = self._evaluate_guardrail()
        self.status = f"Guardrail {res['guardrail_id']} (v{res['guardrail_version']}): {res['action']}"
        return Data(data=res)

    def _resolve_gateway_url(self, gw_id: str, region: str) -> str:
        custom_url = (self.gateway_url or "").strip()
        if custom_url and custom_url != "https://gateway.bedrock-agentcore.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/mcp":
            return custom_url
        clean_id = gw_id.split()[0].strip()
        return f"https://{clean_id}.gateway.bedrock-agentcore.{region}.amazonaws.com/mcp"

    def _gateway_spec(self) -> dict:
        if hasattr(self, "_cached_spec") and self._cached_spec:
            return self._cached_spec

        gw_id = str(self.gateway_id or "").strip()
        clean_id = gw_id.split()[0].strip() if gw_id else ""
        region = self.region_name or "ap-southeast-1"
        query = str(self.tool_query or "").strip()
        endpoint_url = self._resolve_gateway_url(clean_id, region)

        spec: dict = {
            "gateway_role": self.gateway_role,
            "gateway_id": clean_id,
            "auth_mode": self.auth_mode,
            "gateway_url": endpoint_url,
            "region": region,
            "query": query,
        }

        if clean_id and "inbound" not in clean_id.lower():
            try:
                import httpx

                headers = {"MCP-Protocol-Version": "2025-11-25", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
                if self.oauth_bearer_token:
                    headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.oauth_bearer_token}"

                with httpx.Client(timeout=15.0) as client:
                    list_resp = client.post(
                        endpoint_url,
                        headers=headers,
                        json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list", "params": {}},
                    )
                    if list_resp.status_code == 200:
                        tools_meta = list_resp.json().get("result", {}).get("tools", [])
                        spec["mcp_tools_available"] = [t.get("name") for t in tools_meta if isinstance(t, dict)]

                        explicit_tool = (getattr(self, "mcp_tool_name", "") or "").strip()
                        raw_args = (getattr(self, "mcp_tool_arguments_json", "") or "").strip()
                        if explicit_tool:
                            args_dict = json.loads(raw_args) if raw_args else {"query": query}
                            call_resp = client.post(
                                endpoint_url,
                                headers=headers,
                                json={
                                    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                                    "id": 2,
                                    "method": "tools/call",
                                    "params": {"name": explicit_tool, "arguments": args_dict},
                                },
                            )
                            spec["mcp_tool_called"] = explicit_tool
                            spec["mcp_tool_result"] = call_resp.json().get("result", {})
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                spec["mcp_discovery_note"] = str(exc)

        self._cached_spec = spec
        return spec

    def build_gateway_message(self) -> Message:
        spec = self._gateway_spec()
        tools = spec.get("mcp_tools_available") or []
        self.status = (
            f"{spec['gateway_id']} ({len(tools)} MCP tools)"
            if tools
            else f"{spec['gateway_id']} ({spec['auth_mode']})"
        )
        return Message(text=spec["query"])

    def build_gateway_data(self) -> Data:
        spec = self._gateway_spec()
        self.status = f"Gateway {spec['gateway_id']}"
        return Data(data=spec)

class AgentCoreKnowledgeBaseComponent(Component):
    """Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base (S3 + Vector Search) component with dynamic MCP Gateway & SDK support."""

    display_name = "Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base (RAG)"
    description = (
        "Truy vấn tri thức RAG trên Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base (S3 + Vector Search) "
        "trực tiếp qua AWS SDK hoặc thông qua AgentCore Outbound MCP Gateway bất kỳ."
    )
    icon = "Amazon"
    name = "AgentCoreKnowledgeBase"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="search_query",
            display_name="Search Query",
            info="Câu hỏi hoặc từ khóa cần tra cứu trên Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base.",
            value="",
            required=False,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="knowledge_base_id",
            display_name="Knowledge Base ID",
            value="RVAHZPCHQN",
            info="Định danh Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base (10 ký tự).",
            required=True,
        ),
        StrInput(
            name="outbound_gateway_id",
            display_name="Outbound MCP Gateway ID (Optional)",
            value="gateway-retrieval-hr-agent-xcjlmpsg83",
            info="Định danh AgentCore MCP Gateway kết nối tới Knowledge Base (nếu truy xuất qua Gateway).",
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="retrieval_storage",
            display_name="Storage & Search Engine",
            options=[
                "Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base (S3 + Vector Search)",
                "Amazon OpenSearch Serverless Vector Store",
                "Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL (pgvector)",
            ],
            value="Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base (S3 + Vector Search)",
            info="Cơ chế lưu trữ tài liệu nguồn và tìm kiếm vector.",
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="top_k",
            display_name="Top K Results",
            value=5,
            info="Số lượng đoạn tài liệu (chunks) liên quan nhất cần trích xuất.",

        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="region_name",

            options=AWS_REGIONS,
            info="Vùng AWS nơi đặt Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base.",

        SecretStrInput(

            advanced=True,
        ),
        SecretStrInput(
            name="aws_session_token",
            display_name="AWS Session Token",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            display_name="RAG Context Message",
            name="rag_context",
            method="retrieve_rag_message",
        ),
        Output(
            display_name="KB Citations Data",
            name="kb_citations",
            method="retrieve_kb_data",
        ),
    ]

    def _resolve_credentials(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        creds: dict[str, str] = {"region_name": self.region_name or "ap-southeast-1"}
        ak = (self.aws_access_key_id or "").strip()
        sk = (self.aws_secret_access_key or "").strip()
        st = (self.aws_session_token or "").strip()
        if ak in {"AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID", ""}:
            ak = ""
        if sk in {"AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", ""}:
            sk = ""
        if st in {"AWS_SESSION_TOKEN", ""}:
            st = ""

        if ak and sk:
            creds["aws_access_key_id"] = ak
            creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = sk
            if st:
                creds["aws_session_token"] = st
            return creds

        meta_file = Path("/app/deploy/agentcore/aws_deployed_runtimes.json")
        if meta_file.exists():
            try:
                saved = json.loads(meta_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                if saved.get("aws_access_key_id") and saved.get("aws_secret_access_key"):
                    creds["aws_access_key_id"] = saved["aws_access_key_id"]
                    creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = saved["aws_secret_access_key"]
                    if saved.get("aws_session_token"):
                        creds["aws_session_token"] = saved["aws_session_token"]
                    return creds
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass

        if os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID") and os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"):
            creds["aws_access_key_id"] = os.environ["AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"]
            creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = os.environ["AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"]
            if os.environ.get("AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"):
                creds["aws_session_token"] = os.environ["AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"]
        return creds

    def _retrieve_kb(self) -> dict:
        if hasattr(self, "_cached_kb_result") and self._cached_kb_result:
            return self._cached_kb_result

        kb_id = (self.knowledge_base_id or "").strip()
        query = str(self.search_query or "").strip()
        gw_id = (self.outbound_gateway_id or "").strip().split()[0] if self.outbound_gateway_id else ""
        region = self.region_name or "ap-southeast-1"
        top_k = int(self.top_k or 5)

        # 1. Try direct AWS Bedrock Agent Runtime Retrieve API first
        try:
            import boto3

            creds = self._resolve_credentials()
            agent_runtime = boto3.client("bedrock-agent-runtime", **creds)
            resp = agent_runtime.retrieve(
                knowledgeBaseId=kb_id,
                retrievalQuery={"text": query},
                retrievalConfiguration={"vectorSearchConfiguration": {"numberOfResults": top_k}},
            )
            results = resp.get("retrievalResults", [])
            snippets = [
                r.get("content", {}).get("text", "")
                for r in results
                if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("content", {}).get("text")
            ]
            if snippets:
                out = {
                    "status": "RETRIEVED_DIRECT_SDK",
                    "knowledge_base_id": kb_id,
                    "outbound_gateway_id": gw_id,
                    "query": query,
                    "num_chunks": len(snippets),
                    "snippets": snippets[:top_k],
                }
                self._cached_kb_result = out
                return out
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

        # 2. Dynamically discover & call any KB retrieval tool on the configured Outbound MCP Gateway
        if gw_id and query:
            try:
                import httpx

                mcp_url = f"https://{gw_id}.gateway.bedrock-agentcore.{region}.amazonaws.com/mcp"
                headers = {"MCP-Protocol-Version": "2025-11-25", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
                with httpx.Client(timeout=20.0) as client:
                    list_resp = client.post(
                        mcp_url,
                        headers=headers,
                        json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list", "params": {}},
                    )
                    tools = list_resp.json().get("result", {}).get("tools", [])
                    kb_tool_name = None
                    for t in tools:
                        props = t.get("inputSchema", {}).get("properties", {})
                        if "kb_id" in props and "query" in props:
                            kb_tool_name = t.get("name")
                            break
                    if kb_tool_name:
                        mcp_resp = client.post(
                            mcp_url,
                            headers=headers,
                            json={
                                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                                "id": 2,
                                "method": "tools/call",
                                "params": {
                                    "name": kb_tool_name,
                                    "arguments": {"kb_id": kb_id, "query": query, "top_k": top_k},
                                },
                            },
                        )
                        content_blocks = mcp_resp.json().get("result", {}).get("content", [])
                        if content_blocks and content_blocks[0].get("text"):
                            parsed_kb = json.loads(content_blocks[0]["text"])
                            results = parsed_kb.get("results", [])
                            snippets = [
                                f"[{r.get('document_title', 'Document')} - #{r.get('citation_id')}]: {r.get('content', '')}"
                                for r in results
                                if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("content")
                            ]
                            out = {
                                "status": "RETRIEVED_VIA_MCP_GATEWAY",
                                "knowledge_base_id": kb_id,
                                "outbound_gateway_id": gw_id,
                                "mcp_tool": kb_tool_name,
                                "query": query,
                                "num_chunks": len(snippets),
                                "snippets": snippets[:top_k],
                                "citations": results,
                            }
                            self._cached_kb_result = out
                            return out
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                return {
                    "status": "ERROR",
                    "knowledge_base_id": kb_id,
                    "outbound_gateway_id": gw_id,
                    "query": query,
                    "num_chunks": 0,
                    "snippets": [],
                    "error": str(exc),
                }

        return {
            "status": "NO_RESULTS",
            "knowledge_base_id": kb_id,
            "outbound_gateway_id": gw_id,
            "query": query,
            "num_chunks": 0,
            "snippets": [],
        }

    def retrieve_rag_message(self) -> Message:
        res = self._retrieve_kb()
        text = "\n\n".join(res.get("snippets", []))
        self.status = f"KB {res['knowledge_base_id']} ({res['num_chunks']} chunks)"
        return Message(text=text)

    def retrieve_kb_data(self) -> Data:
        res = self._retrieve_kb()
        self.status = res.get("status", "RETRIEVED")
        return Data(data=res)

        clean_id = gw_id.split()[0].strip() if gw_id else ""

            "gateway_id": clean_id,
            "auth_mode": self.auth_mode,
            "gateway_url": endpoint_url,
            "region": region,
            "query": query,
        }

        if clean_id and "inbound" not in clean_id.lower():
            try:
                import httpx

                headers = {"MCP-Protocol-Version": "2025-11-25", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
                if self.oauth_bearer_token:
                    headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self.oauth_bearer_token}"

                with httpx.Client(timeout=15.0) as client:
                    list_resp = client.post(
                        endpoint_url,
                        headers=headers,
                        json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/list", "params": {}},
                    )
                    if list_resp.status_code == 200:
                        tools_meta = list_resp.json().get("result", {}).get("tools", [])
                        spec["mcp_tools_available"] = [t.get("name") for t in tools_meta if isinstance(t, dict)]

                        explicit_tool = (getattr(self, "mcp_tool_name", "") or "").strip()
                        raw_args = (getattr(self, "mcp_tool_arguments_json", "") or "").strip()
                        if explicit_tool:
                            args_dict = json.loads(raw_args) if raw_args else {"query": query}
                            call_resp = client.post(
                                endpoint_url,
                                headers=headers,
                                json={
                                    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                                    "id": 2,
                                    "method": "tools/call",
                                    "params": {"name": explicit_tool, "arguments": args_dict},
                                },
                            )
                            spec["mcp_tool_called"] = explicit_tool
                            spec["mcp_tool_result"] = call_resp.json().get("result", {})
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                spec["mcp_discovery_note"] = str(exc)

        self._cached_spec = spec
        return spec

    def build_gateway_message(self) -> Message:
        spec = self._gateway_spec()
        tools = spec.get("mcp_tools_available") or []
        self.status = (
            f"{spec['gateway_id']} ({len(tools)} MCP tools)"
            if tools
            else f"{spec['gateway_id']} ({spec['auth_mode']})"
        )
        return Message(text=spec["query"])

    def build_gateway_data(self) -> Data:
        spec = self._gateway_spec()
        self.status = f"Gateway {spec['gateway_id']}"
        return Data(data=spec)

import json

from pathlib import Path

from lfx.base.models.aws_constants import AWS_MODEL_IDs, AWS_REGIONS
from lfx.base.models.model import LCModelComponent

# Providers whose Bedrock models document "top_k" as an inference parameter, in the
# range this component's default sits in. The Converse API only accepts
# additionalModelRequestFields the target model actually supports, so sending it
# anywhere else makes Bedrock reject the whole call: Meta takes only
# prompt/temperature/top_p/max_gen_len, Amazon Titan and AI21 have no top_k, and Cohere
# spells it "k". Mistral is excluded too, despite listing top_k for text completion:
# Mistral Large uses the chat-completion schema, which has no top_k at all, and the
# text-completion models cap it below this component's default of 250. Anything outside
# this set can still opt in explicitly through Additional Model Fields.
TOP_K_PROVIDERS = frozenset({"anthropic"})

# Inference profile ids are prefixed with the geography, e.g. "us.anthropic...";
# "global" is the worldwide-routing profile. Mirrors MODEL_ID_GEO_PREFIXES in
# langchain_aws.utils: ChatBedrockConverse strips exactly these before resolving the
# provider, so a shorter set here would drop top_k for models the library still
# resolves to Anthropic. Kept as a literal because the constant only exists in newer
# langchain-aws releases than this bundle's floor.
_INFERENCE_PROFILE_PREFIXES = frozenset({"us", "eu", "apac", "global", "us-gov", "sa", "amer", "jp", "au"})


def _model_provider(model_id: str) -> str:
    """Provider segment of a Bedrock model id, ignoring any cross-region prefix."""
    parts = str(model_id or "").split(".")
    if len(parts) > 1 and parts[0] in _INFERENCE_PROFILE_PREFIXES:
        parts = parts[1:]
    return parts[0] if parts else ""

    def _resolve_aws_credentials(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        ak = (self.aws_access_key_id or "").strip()
        sk = (self.aws_secret_access_key or "").strip()
        st = (self.aws_session_token or "").strip()
        if ak in {"AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID", ""}:
            ak = ""
        if sk in {"AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", ""}:
            sk = ""
        if st in {"AWS_SESSION_TOKEN", ""}:
            st = ""

        if not (ak and sk):
            meta_file = Path("/app/deploy/agentcore/aws_deployed_runtimes.json")
            if meta_file.exists():
                try:
                    saved = json.loads(meta_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    ak = ak or saved.get("aws_access_key_id", "")
                    sk = sk or saved.get("aws_secret_access_key", "")
                    st = st or saved.get("aws_session_token", "")
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pass
            ak = ak or os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "")
            sk = sk or os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", "")
            st = st or os.environ.get("AWS_SESSION_TOKEN", "")
        elif ak.startswith("ASIA") and not st:
            meta_file = Path("/app/deploy/agentcore/aws_deployed_runtimes.json")
            if meta_file.exists():
                try:
                    saved = json.loads(meta_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                    if saved.get("aws_access_key_id") == ak and saved.get("aws_session_token"):
                        st = saved["aws_session_token"]
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pass

        creds: dict[str, str] = {}
        if ak and sk:
            creds["aws_access_key_id"] = ak
            creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = sk
            if st:
                creds["aws_session_token"] = st
        return creds

    def build_model(self) -> LanguageModel:  # type: ignore[type-var]
        try:
            from langchain_aws.chat_models.bedrock_converse import ChatBedrockConverse
        except ImportError as e:
            msg = "langchain_aws is not installed. Please install it with `pip install langchain_aws`."
            raise ImportError(msg) from e

        # Prepare initialization parameters
        init_params = {
            "model": self.model_id,
            "region_name": self.region_name or "ap-southeast-1",
        }

        # Add AWS credentials if provided or resolved
        init_params.update(self._resolve_aws_credentials())
        if self.credentials_profile_name:
            init_params["credentials_profile_name"] = self.credentials_profile_name
        if self.endpoint_url:
            init_params["endpoint_url"] = self.endpoint_url

        # Add model parameters directly as supported by ChatBedrockConverse
        if hasattr(self, "temperature") and self.temperature is not None:
            init_params["temperature"] = self.temperature
        if hasattr(self, "max_tokens") and self.max_tokens is not None:
            init_params["max_tokens"] = self.max_tokens
        if hasattr(self, "top_p") and self.top_p is not None:
            init_params["top_p"] = self.top_p

        # Handle streaming - only disable if explicitly requested
        if hasattr(self, "disable_streaming") and self.disable_streaming:
            init_params["disable_streaming"] = True

        # top_k is not part of the universal Converse API inferenceConfig, so it is
        # passed through additional_model_request_fields like other provider-specific fields.
        additional_model_request_fields = {}
        if hasattr(self, "top_k") and self.top_k is not None and _model_provider(self.model_id) in TOP_K_PROVIDERS:
            additional_model_request_fields["top_k"] = self.top_k

        # additional_model_fields lets users override or extend provider-specific fields,
        # including using a different key for providers that don't accept "top_k".
        if hasattr(self, "additional_model_fields") and self.additional_model_fields:
            for field in self.additional_model_fields:
                if isinstance(field, dict):
                    additional_model_request_fields.update(field)

        # Only add if we have actual additional fields
        if additional_model_request_fields:
            init_params["additional_model_request_fields"] = additional_model_request_fields

        try:
            output = ChatBedrockConverse(**init_params)
        except Exception as e:
            # Provide helpful error message with fallback suggestions
            error_details = str(e)
            if "validation error" in error_details.lower():
                msg = (
                    f"ChatBedrockConverse validation error: {error_details}. "
                    f"This may be due to incompatible parameters for model '{self.model_id}'. "
                    f"Consider adjusting the model parameters or trying the legacy Amazon Bedrock component."
                )
            elif "converse api" in error_details.lower():
                msg = (
                    f"Converse API error: {error_details}. "
                    f"The model '{self.model_id}' may not support the Converse API. "
                    f"Try using the legacy Amazon Bedrock component instead."
                )
            else:
                msg = f"Could not initialize ChatBedrockConverse: {error_details}"
            raise ValueError(msg) from e

        return output

    def _resolve_credentials(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        creds: dict[str, str] = {"region_name": self.region_name or "ap-southeast-1"}
        ak = (self.aws_access_key_id or "").strip()
        sk = (self.aws_secret_access_key or "").strip()
        st = (self.aws_session_token or "").strip()
        if ak in {"AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID", ""}:
            ak = ""
        if sk in {"AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", ""}:
            sk = ""
        if st in {"AWS_SESSION_TOKEN", ""}:
            st = ""

        if ak and sk:
            creds["aws_access_key_id"] = ak
            creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = sk
            if st:
                creds["aws_session_token"] = st
            return creds

        meta_file = Path("/app/deploy/agentcore/aws_deployed_runtimes.json")
        if meta_file.exists():
            try:
                saved = json.loads(meta_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                if saved.get("aws_access_key_id") and saved.get("aws_secret_access_key"):
                    creds["aws_access_key_id"] = saved["aws_access_key_id"]
                    creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = saved["aws_secret_access_key"]
                    if saved.get("aws_session_token"):
                        creds["aws_session_token"] = saved["aws_session_token"]
                    return creds
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass

        if os.environ.get("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID") and os.environ.get("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"):
            creds["aws_access_key_id"] = os.environ["AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"]
            creds["aws_secret_access_key"] = os.environ["AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"]
            if os.environ.get("AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"):
                creds["aws_session_token"] = os.environ["AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"]
        return creds

    def _invoke_harness_stream(self, client, harness_arn: str, session_id: str, prompt_text: str) -> dict:
        """Invoke an AWS Bedrock AgentCore Harness natively via `invoke_harness` and parse streaming events."""
        kwargs: dict = {
            "harnessArn": harness_arn,
            "runtimeSessionId": session_id,
            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": prompt_text}]}],
        }
        actor = (getattr(self, "actor_id", "") or "").strip()
        if actor:
            kwargs["actorId"] = actor

        resp = client.invoke_harness(**kwargs)
        reasoning_chunks: list[str] = []
        turn_text_chunks: list[str] = []
        final_text_chunks: list[str] = []
        tools_called: list[dict] = []
        current_tool: dict | None = None
        current_tool_result_id: str | None = None
        current_tool_result_chunks: list[str] = []
        usage_metrics: dict = {}
        reasoning_duration_ms = 0

        for event in resp.get("stream", []):
            if "contentBlockStart" in event:
                start = event["contentBlockStart"].get("start", {})
                if "toolUse" in start:
                    current_tool = {
                        "toolUseId": start["toolUse"].get("toolUseId"),
                        "name": start["toolUse"].get("name"),
                        "input": "",
                    }
                elif "toolResult" in start:
                    current_tool_result_id = start["toolResult"].get("toolUseId")
                    current_tool_result_chunks = []
            elif "contentBlockDelta" in event:
                delta = event["contentBlockDelta"].get("delta", {})
                if "reasoningContent" in delta:
                    r_text = delta["reasoningContent"].get("text", "")
                    if r_text:
                        reasoning_chunks.append(r_text)
                elif "text" in delta:
                    turn_text_chunks.append(delta["text"])
                elif "toolUse" in delta and current_tool is not None:
                    current_tool["input"] += delta["toolUse"].get("input", "")
                elif "toolResult" in delta and current_tool_result_id is not None:
                    for item in delta["toolResult"]:
                        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("text"):
                            current_tool_result_chunks.append(item["text"])
            elif "contentBlockStop" in event:
                if current_tool is not None:
                    tools_called.append(current_tool)
                    current_tool = None
                if current_tool_result_id is not None and current_tool_result_chunks:
                    joined_res = "".join(current_tool_result_chunks)
                    for t in tools_called:
                        if t.get("toolUseId") == current_tool_result_id:
                            t["output"] = joined_res
                    current_tool_result_id = None
                    current_tool_result_chunks = []
            elif "messageStop" in event:
                stop_reason = event["messageStop"].get("stopReason", "")
                turn_str = "".join(turn_text_chunks).strip()
                turn_text_chunks = []
                if stop_reason == "tool_use":
                    if turn_str:
                        reasoning_chunks.append(turn_str)
                elif turn_str:
                    final_text_chunks.append(turn_str)
            elif "metadata" in event:
                usage_metrics = event["metadata"]
                lat = usage_metrics.get("metrics", {}).get("latencyMs", 0)
                if not reasoning_duration_ms and lat:
                    reasoning_duration_ms = int(lat)

        if turn_text_chunks:
            final_text_chunks.append("".join(turn_text_chunks).strip())

        full_text = "\n\n".join(c for c in final_text_chunks if c).strip()
        if "<<<SUGGESTIONS>>>" in full_text:
            full_text = full_text.split("<<<SUGGESTIONS>>>", 1)[0].strip()

        preamble, cleaned_answer = _split_reasoning_preamble(full_text)
        if preamble:
            reasoning_chunks.append(preamble)
            full_text = cleaned_answer

        reasoning_text = "\n\n".join(c.strip() for c in reasoning_chunks if c.strip()).strip()
        if not reasoning_text and tools_called:
            tool_summaries = [f"{t.get('name')}({t.get('input', '')})" for t in tools_called]
            reasoning_text = (
                f"Để trả lời chính xác câu hỏi của bạn, tôi cần tra cứu thông tin qua hệ thống công cụ. "
                f"Tôi sẽ sử dụng công cụ tìm kiếm ({', '.join(tool_summaries)}) để kiểm tra thông tin này."
            )

        return {
            "status": "SUCCESS",
            "invocation_type": "InvokeHarness",
            "target_arn": harness_arn,
            "framework": self.agent_framework,
            "session_id": session_id,
            "reasoning": reasoning_text,
            "reasoning_duration_ms": reasoning_duration_ms or 3200,
            "tools_called": tools_called,
            "usage_metrics": usage_metrics,
            "response": full_text,
        }

    def _invoke_runtime_direct(self, client, runtime_arn: str, session_id: str, prompt_text: str) -> dict:
        """Invoke an AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime natively via `invoke_agent_runtime`."""
        payload_dict: dict = {"prompt": prompt_text}
        actor = (getattr(self, "actor_id", "") or "").strip()
        if actor:
            payload_dict["actor_id"] = actor

        resp = client.invoke_agent_runtime(
            agentRuntimeArn=runtime_arn,
            runtimeSessionId=session_id,
            payload=json.dumps(payload_dict).encode("utf-8"),
            qualifier="DEFAULT",
        )
        raw_body = resp["response"].read().decode("utf-8")
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(raw_body)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            parsed = {"result": raw_body}

        res_field = parsed.get("result", parsed)
        if isinstance(res_field, dict) and isinstance(res_field.get("content"), list):
            clean_answer = "\n".join(
                block.get("text", "")
                for block in res_field["content"]
                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("text")
            ).strip()
        elif isinstance(res_field, str):
            clean_answer = res_field
        else:
            clean_answer = json.dumps(res_field, ensure_ascii=False)

        for marker in ("• Kết quả xử lý trên AWS:", "Kết quả xử lý trên AWS:"):
            if marker in clean_answer:
                clean_answer = clean_answer.split(marker, 1)[-1].strip()
                break

        preamble, clean_answer = _split_reasoning_preamble(clean_answer)

        return {
            "status": "SUCCESS",
            "invocation_type": "InvokeAgentRuntime",
            "target_arn": runtime_arn,
            "framework": self.agent_framework,
            "session_id": session_id,
            "reasoning": preamble,
            "reasoning_duration_ms": 2500 if preamble else 0,
            "tools_called": [],
            "response": clean_answer,
            "raw_payload": parsed,
        }

    def _execute_invocation(self) -> dict:
        if hasattr(self, "_cached_invocation_result") and self._cached_invocation_result:
            return self._cached_invocation_result

        arn = (self.custom_runtime_arn or "").strip() or self.runtime_target
        raw_session = (self.session_id or "").strip()
        session_id = raw_session if len(raw_session) >= 33 else f"langflow-agentcore-session-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        prompt_text = str(self.input_value or "").strip()

        import boto3

        creds = self._resolve_credentials()
        client = boto3.client("bedrock-agentcore", **creds)

        if ":harness/" in arn:
            result = self._invoke_harness_stream(client, arn, session_id, prompt_text)
        else:
            result = self._invoke_runtime_direct(client, arn, session_id, prompt_text)

        self._cached_invocation_result = result
        return result

    def invoke_runtime_message(self) -> Message:
        result = self._execute_invocation()
        text = str(result.get("response", ""))
        reasoning_text = str(result.get("reasoning", "") or "").strip()
        reasoning_ms = int(result.get("reasoning_duration_ms", 0) or 3000)
        tools_called = result.get("tools_called", [])

        contents = []
        if reasoning_text:
            contents.append(
                ReasoningContent(
                    text=reasoning_text,
                    duration=reasoning_ms,
                    header={"title": f"Reasoning ({round(reasoning_ms / 1000, 1)}s)", "icon": "Sparkles"},
                )
            )
        for t in tools_called:
            if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("name"):
                raw_out = t.get("output")
                parsed_out = raw_out
                if isinstance(raw_out, str):
                    try:
                        parsed_out = json.loads(raw_out)
                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                        parsed_out = raw_out
                contents.append(
                    ToolContent(
                        id=t.get("toolUseId"),
                        name=t["name"],
                        tool_input=t.get("input", {}),
                        output=parsed_out,
                        duration=1200,
                        header={"title": f"MCP Tool: {t['name']}", "icon": "Wrench"},
                    )
                )

        content_blocks = [ContentBlock(title="Agent Steps", contents=contents)] if contents else []
        tool_names = [t.get("name") for t in tools_called if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("name")]
        self.status = f"Tools: {', '.join(tool_names)}" if tool_names else result.get("status", "SUCCESS")
        return Message(text=text, content_blocks=content_blocks)

    def invoke_runtime_metadata(self) -> Data:
        result = self._execute_invocation()
        self.status = result.get("status", "SUCCESS")
        return Data(data=result)

            self.session_id or existing_session_id or (self.graph.session_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None) or ""
        )
        message.context_id = self.context_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)

        # Store message if needed
        if message.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        # Set accumulated token usage from all upstream LLM vertices.
        # This must happen AFTER send_message() because streaming captures
        # usage from chunks and would overwrite accumulated totals.
        if hasattr(self, "_vertex") and self._vertex is not None:
            accumulated_usage = self._vertex._accumulate_upstream_token_usage()  # noqa: SLF001
            if accumulated_usage:
                message.properties.usage = accumulated_usage
                if self.should_store_message and message.get_id():
                    message = await self._update_stored_message(message)
                    await self._send_message_event(message, id_=message.get_id())

        self.status = message
        return message

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        clean_data: bool = getattr(self, "clean_data", False)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value, clean_data=clean_data)
